title: SMF crash
body:
Hey @acetcom 

I've been running tests with my previously working configs, and have found that the SMF is now regularly crashing - ie whenever a UE attempts to attach.

Running MME/HSS/PCRF/SMF/NRF on one server, SGW/UPF on another, so SMF/UPF is acting as a PGW here.


smf.yaml
```
logger:
    file: /var/log/open5gs/smf.log

parameter:

smf:
    sbi:
      - addr: 127.0.0.4
        port: 7777
    freeDiameter: /etc/freeDiameter/smf.conf
    gtpc:
      - addr: 10.10.0.4 	#S5/8C local bind
    pfcp:
      - addr: 10.10.0.4 	#N4 local bind
    pdn:
      - addr: 10.45.0.1/16
        apn: internet
    dns:
      - 1.1.1.1
      - 8.8.8.8
    mtu: 1400

nrf:
    sbi:
      addr: 127.0.0.7
      port: 7777
      
upf:
    pfcp:
      - addr: 10.10.0.3 	#N4 cloudUPF ((DEFAULT))
```

Not sure what is causing this, as this part of the code has not changed for some time. Guessing it is a change in 
`/src/smf/context.c`
